data.purpose: Feasibility of a supported Node24 LTS runtime using native type stripping on both arms, identical source/dependency/WASM bytes. Existing compile worker and timing boundary; four fresh processes in ABBA order, CPU2, 5 warmups and 3 measured compiles. Every output must match saved track and charged work. This diagnostic does not qualify a candidate or establish the absolute target.
data.gate: At least 2% exploratory improvement before undertaking full runtime requalification. No changes to equations, outputs or benchmark policy to accommodate the runtime. A promising diagnostic still needs full structural validation, exact checkpoints, frozen 12-pair screen/24-pair confirmation, larger12(+2%), cold12(+5%), same resource bounds (WASM1.05,RSS1.15), native null control. Reject if parity fails.

Existing compile worker and timing boundary; four fresh processes in ABBA order, CPU2, 5 warmups and 3 measured compiles. Every output must match saved track and charged work. This diagnostic does not qualify a candidate or establish the absolute target.','runtime':{'version':version,'archiveUrl':url,'archiveSha256':expected,'source':'https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.22.2'},'gate':'At least 2% exploratory improvement before undertaking full runtime requalification. No changes to equations, outputs or benchmark policy to accommodate the runtime. A promising diagnostic still needs full structural validation, exact checkpoints, frozen 12-pair screen/24-pair confirmation, larger12(+2%), cold12(+5%), same resource bounds (WASM1.05,RSS1.15), native null control. Reject if parity fails.'}
assert not (base/'plan.json').exists();(base/'plan.json').write_text(json.dumps(plan,indent=2)+'\n')
with urllib.request.urlopen(url) as source,(base/archive).open('wb') as target:
 while data:=source.read(1024*1024):target.write(data)
assert hashlib.sha256((base/archive).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
with tarfile.open(base/archive,'r:xz') as tar:tar.extractall(base,filter='data')
new=base/f'node-v{version}-linux-x64/bin/node';old=Path('/usr/bin/node')
runtimes=[]
for binary in [old,new]:
 info=json.loads(subprocess.check_output([str(binary),'-p','JSON.stringify({node:process.version,v8:process.versions.v8,execPath:process.execPath,lts:process.release.lts})'],text=True));info['binarySha256']=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest();runtimes.append(info)
(base/'runtimes.json').write_text(json.dumps(runtimes,indent=2)+'\n')
config={'mode':'compile','stage':'screen','rounds':12,'confirmRounds':24,'reps':3,'warmup':5,'confidence':.95,'marginPct':0,'seed':1729,'slowdownPct':0,'cells':[61]};(base/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(config,indent=2)+'\n')
results=[]
for i,arm in enumerate([0,1,1,0]):
 out=base/f'probe-{i}-{arm}.json'
 subprocess.run(['taskset','-c','2',str([old,new][arm]),'--expose-gc',str(root/'tools/measure/engine_ab.ts'),'--worker','--config='+str(base/'protocol.json'),'--result='+str(out),'--verify=false'],cwd=root,check=True)
 r=json.loads(out.read_text());results.append({'sequence':i,'arm':arm,'nsPerFrame':r['nsPerFrame']});print(results[-1],flush=True)
medians=[statistics.median(r['nsPerFrame'] for r in results if r['arm']==a) for a in [0,1]]
(base/'diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps({'results':results,'medians':medians,'medianRatio':medians[1]/medians[0],'qualified':False},indent=2)+'\n')
